cells.gaps: Every admissible row is from 2017/18: a pilot in Gabu region alone, with learner records collected school by school and keyed at a regional hub, no entry by the schools themselves and no count of schools. Nothing says whether the pilot continued or was extended. Owner (partner) and finance (donor) are held only from 2018, outside the 36 months, so governance is empty; nothing in the last twelve months. GNB-001 to GNB-003 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: A pilot of a system holding a record per learner, in one region's basic and secondary schools, is stage 2. Stage 3 needs the system past its pilot and live in some primary schools, and the only source calls it a pilot.
